docs.title: Privacy Policy – CicloBeef Studio
docs.text:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

CicloBeef Studio respects the privacy of customers, visitors and people who contact us. This Privacy Policy explains, at a customer-facing level, what information we may process, why we use it, when it may be shared and the choices available to you.

docs.title: Information you provide
docs.text:
Depending on how you interact with us, you may provide:

  • Name and contact details, such as email address and telephone number.
  • Billing, delivery and location information, such as country, region, city, postal code and shipping address.
  • Product selections, quantities, order details and transaction status.
  • Messages, customer-support requests, feedback and other communications.
  • Information needed to assess a cancellation, return, refund, damaged product or delivery issue.

Please do not send sensitive personal information or complete payment-card credentials by email, social media or general contact messages.

docs.title: Information generated through website use
docs.text:
When you use the website, storefront or checkout, limited technical and usage information may be generated, such as:

  • Internet Protocol address, browser, device type and operating-system information.
  • Pages or features used, referring information, timestamps and general interaction data.
  • Essential cookie, session or local-storage identifiers used to operate the website, cart, security or checkout.
  • Diagnostic, performance, fraud-prevention and security information.

The precise information available may depend on your device, browser settings and the services used to provide the website and checkout.

docs.title: 2. How We Use Information
docs.text:
We may process personal information to:

  • Operate the website, product catalog, cart and checkout.
  • Process orders, confirm payment status and maintain transaction records.
  • Prepare, produce, fulfill, ship and track purchases.
  • Respond to enquiries and provide customer support.
  • Manage cancellations, returns, refunds, damaged products and delivery issues.
  • Communicate service, order, security or policy updates.
  • Prevent fraud, misuse, unauthorized activity and security incidents.
  • Diagnose technical problems and maintain service reliability.
  • Comply with legal, tax, accounting, recordkeeping and dispute-resolution obligations.
  • Understand service performance and customer interactions where lawful analytics are used.

We do not sell personal information in exchange for money.

docs.title: 3. Payments and Payment Information
docs.text:
Payment information is processed through authorized third-party payment services such as PayPal. Eligible customers may also be offered credit card or debit card options through the PayPal checkout experience.

CicloBeef Studio does not require customers to provide complete payment-card credentials directly to the studio when those credentials are handled by the payment processor. We may receive transaction information needed to manage an order, such as the payer’s name, contact or delivery details, payment status, amount, currency and transaction reference, but not the customer’s complete card number or security code from that processor flow.

Payment processors handle information under their own privacy notices, terms and security practices. The payment options and information requested may vary according to eligibility, location and transaction context.

docs.title: 4. Cookies, Essential Storage and Analytics
docs.text:
The website and commerce services may use cookies or similar storage that is necessary to maintain sessions, remember a cart, support checkout, protect transactions, balance traffic or preserve security preferences.

Service providers may also use cookies or similar technologies under their own notices. If optional analytics or other non-essential tracking is introduced where consent or additional notice is required, the relevant information and controls should be presented before or when that processing begins.

You can use browser settings to restrict or delete cookies, although doing so may prevent the cart, checkout or other website features from working correctly.

docs.title: 5. Service Providers and Information Sharing
docs.text:
We may share only the information reasonably necessary with service providers that support the customer relationship, including categories such as:

  • Commerce and website service providers.
  • Payment processors.
  • Production or fulfillment partners.
  • Shipping, logistics and delivery providers.
  • Customer-support, communications and email providers.
  • Hosting, security, diagnostics and analytics providers, where applicable.
  • Professional advisers or public authorities when disclosure is legally required or reasonably necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal rights.

These parties may process information only for their services, legal obligations or other purposes described in their own applicable notices. We may also disclose information in connection with a lawful business reorganization, provided appropriate protections apply.

docs.title: 6. International Processing
docs.text: Because orders and services may involve customers and providers in different countries, personal information may be processed outside your country of residence. Where required, we take reasonable steps to use appropriate contractual, organizational or legal safeguards for international processing.

docs.title: 7. Data Retention
docs.text:
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including to:

  • Complete and support an order or customer relationship.
  • Maintain required commercial, tax, accounting and transaction records.
  • Resolve disputes, enforce agreements and respond to claims.
  • Prevent fraud and protect website or transaction security.
  • Meet applicable legal obligations.

Retention periods vary according to the type of information, the transaction, applicable law and whether an unresolved issue requires the information to be kept. When information is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to delete, anonymize or securely dispose of it.

docs.title: 8. Security
docs.text:
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure. Payment details handled by a payment processor are protected through that provider’s systems and practices.

No internet transmission or storage method can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Customers should protect their accounts and devices and should contact us if they suspect unauthorized activity connected with an order or communication.

docs.title: 9. Your Privacy Rights and Choices
docs.text:
Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to:

  • Request access to personal information associated with you.
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Request deletion of information when continued retention is not required or permitted.
  • Object to or request restriction of certain processing.
  • Request portability of eligible information.
  • Withdraw consent where processing relies on consent, without affecting earlier lawful processing.
  • Complain to an applicable data-protection authority.

These rights may be subject to lawful exceptions, identity verification and record-retention requirements. To make a request, contact us using the address below and describe the request clearly. We will use the information necessary to verify and respond to it.

docs.title: 10. Third-Party Links and Services
docs.text: The website may link to or operate with third-party services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own notices, and we encourage you to review those notices before providing information directly to them.

docs.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
docs.text: We may update this policy to reflect changes in services, commercial practices, legal requirements or privacy standards. The current version and revision date will be published on this page. Where required, significant changes will be communicated through an appropriate additional notice.

docs.title: 12. Contact
docs.text:
For privacy questions or requests, contact:

contact@ciclobeefstudio.com

docs.title: Mission
docs.text: To connect people worldwide with history and society through premium artistic creations that combine visual excellence, research and critical reflection.

docs.title: Vision
docs.text: To build a catalog of artworks and visual narratives that can be exhibited, collected and integrated into projects led by museums, institutions, foundations and private collectors around the world.

docs.title: Objectives
docs.text:
• Offer high-quality, curated art pieces with strong historical and social content.
  • Provide a professional and reliable experience to international clients.
  • Document our work transparently and with academic rigor.
  • Prepare the technical foundation to integrate automation tools (e.g. Meta Graph API) into our communication and services.

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
Ciclobeef Studio operates with an international focus:

  • Geographical scope: North America, Europe, Latin America and other regions open to premium framed art and curated visual projects.
  • Client segments: collectors, galleries, institutions, cultural projects and curated spaces with high visual standards.
  • Medium: framed artworks, digital previews and documentation prepared for online and offline presentation.

docs.title: Future Technical Integration
docs.text:
As part of our roadmap, Ciclobeef Studio will incorporate technical layers to:

  • Automate communication and content distribution through Meta platforms.
  • Provide APIs or endpoints to integrate with other systems (backends, dashboards, CRMs).
  • Enable data-driven insights about audience response and campaign performance.

This document serves as a reference point for aligning the artistic vision with the technical roadmap.

docs.title: Ciclobeef Studio – Brand & Style Guide (v0.3.0)
docs.text: This document defines the visual and editorial foundations of the Ciclobeef Studio website and related digital products. It must be followed by anyone who creates or updates UI, documentation, or frontend components.

docs.title: 1. Brand Identity
docs.text: Brand name: Ciclobeef Studio Tagline: High-end art, history and society Primary language of the website: English (international audience)

docs.title: 1.1 Mission
docs.text: To connect people worldwide with historical, political and social narratives through high-end visual art, combining research-based storytelling with premium presentation.

docs.title: 1.2 Vision
docs.text: To become a global reference for curated art pieces that document critical moments of history and society, serving collectors, institutions and cultural projects.

docs.title: 1.3 Core Values
docs.text:
• Elegance – visual and narrative quality in every piece and page.
  • Research – historically informed content, not superficial decoration.
  • Impact – works that invite reflection on culture, conflict and identity.
  • Exclusivity – limited, premium offerings, not mass-produced decor.

docs.title: 2. Color Palette
docs.text:
All UI work must use this palette as the primary reference.

  • Primary: #1A1A1A – Deep black / charcoal
  • Use for: main text, headers, footer background.
  • Secondary (Gold/Bronze): #BFA56D
  • Use for: primary buttons, key accents, call-to-action highlights.
  • Accent (Dark Red): #8B0000
  • Use for: hover states, emphasis, warnings, artistic highlights.
  • Light Background: #F5F5F5
  • Use for: hero sections, cards, separated blocks.
  • Body Background: #FFFFFF
  • Use for: page content area.
  • Neutral Gray: #777777
  • Use for: secondary text, muted labels, metadata.

Rule: Never introduce new brand colors in the UI without updating this guide first.

docs.title: 3.1 Typefaces
docs.text:
• Headings: “Playfair Display”, serif
  • Fallbacks: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
  • Body text: “Inter”, sans-serif
  • Fallbacks: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

Note: If a given environment does not support the primary fonts, the fallbacks must keep the same tone: elegant serif for headings, clean sans-serif for body text.

docs.title: 3.2 Hierarchy
docs.text:
• H1 (Page title)
  • Font: Playfair Display
  • Size (desktop): ~2.5rem
  • Weight: 700
  • Margin top: 3.5rem
  • H2 (Section title)
  • Font: Playfair Display
  • Size: ~2rem
  • Weight: 600
  • Margin top: 2.5rem
  • Body text
  • Font: Inter
  • Size: 1rem
  • Line height: 1.6
  • Quotes / Emphasis
  • Style: italic
  • Color: #8B0000 when appropriate

Rule: Each page should have exactly one main H1. Subsections use H2/H3 for logical structure, not for visual “boldness only”.

docs.title: 4.1 Primary Button
docs.text:
CSS class: .btn-primary

  • Background: #BFA56D
  • Text color: #FFFFFF
  • Padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem
  • Border radius: 4px
  • Font weight: 600
  • Display: inline-block

Hover state:

  • Background: #8B0000
  • Text color: #FFFFFF (unchanged)

docs.title: 4.2 Links
docs.text:
• Default color: #BFA56D
  • Hover: #8B0000
  • No underline by default; underline allowed for emphasis in long paragraphs.

Links must be meaningful: avoid “click here”; prefer “view our project overview”, etc.

docs.title: 5.1 Page Layout
docs.text:
• Content container:
  • Max width: ~1100px (.container)
  • Horizontal padding: ~1.5rem
  • White space is part of the visual hierarchy: avoid cramming elements.

docs.title: 5.2 Header
docs.text:
Class: .ciclo-header

  • Background: #1A1A1A
  • Text: #FFFFFF
  • Bottom border: 2px solid #BFA56D
  • Contains: logo / brand name and main navigation.

docs.title: 5.3 Footer
docs.text:
Class: .ciclo-footer

  • Background: #1A1A1A
  • Text: #F5F5F5
  • Content: legal notice, contact email, copyright.

docs.title: 6. Images and Art Direction
docs.text:
• Use high-resolution images of artworks, but optimized for web.
  • Max width in hero sections: ~1200px.
  • All images:
  • Must have alt text describing the subject (accessibility).
  • Should use subtle border radius (~6px).
  • Should avoid heavy filters that distort the original art.

Visual tone: serious, reflective, with controlled contrast and sobriety.

docs.title: 7. Spacing Rules
docs.text:
• Base line height: 1.6 for paragraphs.
  • Vertical spacing:
  • Section top margin: 3–4rem on desktop, 2rem on mobile.
  • Paragraph spacing: 1.5rem.
  • Avoid stacking more than 3 different typographic styles in a single block (e.g. bold + italic + color + caps).

docs.title: 8. Versioning
docs.text:
This guide is tied to the web release cycle.

  • v0.1.0 – Initial docs and project setup.
  • v0.2.0 – CI/CD, GitFlow, static site deployed.
  • v0.3.0 – Corporate branding and style guide formalized (this document).
  • v0.4.0 – Planned: backend foundation (FastAPI + Meta Graph API).

Any visual or structural change that affects multiple pages must be reflected in this document and released under a new version tag.

docs.title: 9. GitFlow Workflow Reference
docs.text:
Ciclobeef Studio uses a GitFlow-like branching model:

  • main – production-ready code.
  • develop – integration branch for the next release.
  • feature/* – new work units (e.g. feature/design-v3).
  • release/* – release stabilization branches (e.g. release/0.3.0).
  • Tags – mark published versions (e.g. v0.3.0).

Example flow for this release:

  1. Start feature from develop: feature/design-v3
  2. Merge into develop.
  3. Create release/0.3.0 from develop.
  4. Merge release/0.3.0 into main.
  5. Tag v0.3.0 and deploy.

This model is based on widely documented GitFlow practices adapted for release-based workflows.:contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

docs.title: Our Team
docs.text: Ciclobeef Studio brings together professionals in art, design, research and technology. Our combined experience allows us to approach each piece as both an artistic and an intellectual project.

docs.title: Core Team (Representative Roles)
docs.text:
Art Direction & Curation Leads the artistic concept, visual coherence and narrative direction of each piece.

Historical & Social Research Ensures that every work is grounded in reliable sources, contextual analysis and ethical considerations.

Visual Design & Production Transforms concepts and research into finished visual pieces ready for high-end printing and framing.

Technology & Automation Designs and maintains the technical foundation for digital presence, documentation, APIs and future automation with Meta Graph API and other platforms.

docs.title: How We Work
docs.text:
• We treat each project as a collaboration between art, research and technology.
  • We document our process and decisions to maintain transparency and reproducibility.
  • We design with international standards in mind, aiming for long-term relevance and institutional compatibility.

docs.title: Terms and Conditions – CicloBeef Studio
docs.text:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

These Terms and Conditions govern access to https://ciclobeefstudio.com and purchases from CicloBeef Studio. By using the website or placing an order, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or purchase our products.

docs.title: 1. Business and Service Scope
docs.text: CicloBeef Studio offers a curated selection of art, décor, apparel, seasonal pieces and other lifestyle products. Some products may be prepared, produced or fulfilled after an order is placed. Custom or special requests, when available, may be subject to additional written terms agreed with the customer.

docs.title: 2. Customer Eligibility and Responsibilities
docs.text:
You must be legally able to enter into a purchase contract in your location or act with the authorization of a parent, guardian or other legally responsible person.

You are responsible for:

  • Providing complete and accurate contact, billing and delivery information.
  • Reviewing the selected product, variant, color, size, quantity and other options before checkout.
  • Ensuring that the payment method you use is authorized.
  • Complying with laws that apply to your purchase, receipt and use of the product.

Please contact us promptly if you identify an error in an order. Changes may not be possible after processing or production has begun.

docs.title: 3. Product Information
docs.text:
We aim to present product descriptions, images, dimensions, materials, colors, availability and configuration options accurately. Screen settings, lighting, materials, production methods and handcrafted or manufactured variations may result in reasonable differences from online images.

Product availability may change without notice. We may correct typographical, pricing or product-information errors when identified. Nothing in this section limits rights that cannot be excluded under applicable consumer law when a product is defective, damaged, incomplete or materially different from its description.

docs.title: 4. Pricing, Taxes and Charges
docs.text:
Prices are displayed in the currency shown in the storefront or checkout. The amount presented at checkout may include or separately identify applicable shipping charges, taxes or other charges.

For international orders, customs duties, import taxes, handling charges or similar destination-based costs may apply. Unless the checkout or applicable law states otherwise, those charges are the customer’s responsibility and are determined by the relevant authorities or service providers.

docs.title: 5. Orders and Acceptance
docs.text:
Submitting an order is an offer to purchase the selected products. An on-screen acknowledgement or payment authorization confirms receipt of the order but does not necessarily mean that the order has been accepted for fulfillment.

We may review an order before acceptance and may decline or cancel it where reasonably necessary, including because of product unavailability, an evident pricing or description error, payment or fraud concerns, delivery restrictions, or information that cannot be verified. If an order cannot be accepted after payment, any amount due back will be handled through the original payment channel, subject to the payment processor’s procedures and applicable law.

docs.title: 6. Payments
docs.text:
Payments may be processed securely through PayPal, including eligible credit card and debit card payment options made available through the PayPal checkout experience. The payment options shown to a customer may depend on location, eligibility, transaction details and the payment processor’s own requirements.

Payment authorization, processing, currency conversion and related payment services are governed by the terms and privacy practices presented by the payment processor. CicloBeef Studio does not claim to offer payment methods that are not displayed and available during the customer’s checkout.

An order may remain unconfirmed if payment is declined, reversed, incomplete or under review.

docs.title: 7. Shipping and Delivery
docs.text:
Available shipping methods, destinations and charges are shown during checkout where applicable. Orders may be prepared and delivered with the assistance of production, fulfillment, logistics and shipping service providers.

Production, dispatch and delivery timeframes are estimates unless CicloBeef Studio expressly agrees to a specific deadline in writing. Delivery may be affected by destination, carrier operations, customs, weather, peak periods, address issues or other circumstances outside our reasonable control.

Tracking information will be provided when available. The customer is responsible for monitoring delivery updates and promptly responding to reasonable carrier or customs requests.

docs.title: 8. Cancellations, Changes, Returns and Refunds
docs.text:
Requests to cancel or change an order should be submitted as soon as possible. Once processing, production or fulfillment has begun, a cancellation or change may no longer be possible.

Return and refund eligibility depends on the product, its condition, the reason for the request, the stage of fulfillment and any mandatory rights that apply. Made-to-order, customized or personalized products may be subject to lawful return restrictions.

Do not return a product without first contacting CicloBeef Studio for instructions. Nothing in these terms excludes a mandatory right of withdrawal, consumer guarantee or remedy that applies under law.

docs.title: 9. Damaged, Defective, Incorrect, Incomplete or Missing Orders
docs.text:
If a product arrives damaged, defective, incorrect or incomplete, or if a shipment appears to be missing, contact us as soon as reasonably possible. Please include the order reference and a clear description of the issue.

We may request photographs of the product, packaging, shipping label and visible damage when reasonably necessary to assess the claim. Depending on the circumstances, available evidence and applicable law, an appropriate remedy may include replacement, refund or another reasonable solution.

docs.title: 10. Acceptable Website Use
docs.text:
You may use this website only for lawful personal or commercial enquiries and purchases. You must not:

  • Interfere with the website, checkout or services.
  • Attempt unauthorized access to accounts, systems or data.
  • Submit false, deceptive or fraudulent information.
  • Use automated methods in a way that disrupts service or imposes an unreasonable load.
  • Copy, misuse or commercially exploit protected content without authorization.

We may restrict access where reasonably necessary to protect customers, the business or the website.

docs.title: 11. Intellectual Property
docs.text:
The website, brand, original artworks, designs, photographs, text and other creative materials are owned by CicloBeef Studio or used with permission from the relevant rights holder.

Purchasing a product does not transfer intellectual-property rights or grant permission to copy, reproduce, distribute, publish, mint, resell as a reproduction or commercially exploit protected creative material without prior written authorization.

docs.title: 12. Third-Party Services
docs.text:
The website and order process may rely on third-party commerce services, payment processors, production or fulfillment partners, logistics providers and other service providers. Their services may be governed by their own terms and privacy notices.

References or links to third-party services do not transfer responsibility to CicloBeef Studio for matters outside its reasonable control. This does not affect any responsibility or customer right that cannot legally be excluded.

docs.title: 13. Limitation of Liability
docs.text:
To the extent permitted by law, CicloBeef Studio is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential losses arising from website use, delays outside its reasonable control or third-party services outside its control.

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, or any warranty, guarantee, remedy or consumer protection that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

docs.title: 14. Changes to These Terms
docs.text: We may update these terms to reflect changes in products, services, legal requirements or commercial practices. The current version and revision date will be published on this page. Changes apply from publication unless applicable law requires otherwise.

docs.title: 15. Legal Framework
docs.text: This website is operated from Santiago, Chile. Chilean law provides the general legal framework for CicloBeef Studio, without excluding mandatory consumer protections or other rights that may apply in the customer’s place of residence.

docs.title: 16. Contact and Support
docs.text:
For order questions, support requests or notices relating to these terms, contact:

contact@ciclobeefstudio.com
